Based on the provided passages, here is how to retrieve deleted texts on an Android device:

1. Run the Android SMS Recovery tool on your PC and connect your Android device to the computer via USB cable.
2. Enable USB debugging on your Android device and let the program identify it.
3. Click "Start" to scan data on your Android device.
4. Preview the recoverable messages in the scan result and mark those you need.
5. Click the "Recover" button to retrieve deleted text messages from Android.

Alternatively, you can use SMS Backup & Restore, which is available on the Google Play Store. This app allows you to back up and restore your text messages, including those that have been deleted. To restore deleted texts using SMS Backup & Restore, follow these steps:

1. Open the app and select the "Messages" tab.
2. Scroll down to the "Deleted Messages" section and select the messages you want to recover.
3. Tap the "Restore" button at the bottom right of the screen to restore the selected messages to your device.

Please note that the effectiveness of these methods may vary depending on the specific situation and the condition of your device. Additionally, it's important to ensure that you are using a reliable and trustworthy recovery software or app to avoid any potential risks or data loss.
